verdict.rationale: Apify supports exporting dataset results in open formats (CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML) via API/client, and offers a CLI/API for programmatic data retrieval, which supports leaving with data. However, evidence covers only dataset exports, not full account/actor/config portability or bulk full-account export mechanisms. missing for 10: evidence of exporting Actors' source code/config/full account data, explicit 'data portability' or account-export documentation, independent confirmation of complete lock-in-free migration.
